svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Blank 220 x 110 mm, 4 mm aluminium, square; round the corners 3 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Sizes from the signal end (left edge) and the centre line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Board fixings: six 3.4 mm holes, countersunk 90 degrees from

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the BOTTOM face to 6.6 mm so M3 countersunk heads sit flush:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 17 from the left edge 40 each side; 133 in, 44 each side;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fuse holder: four M4 tapped holes (drill 3.3) at 178 and 212 in,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 21 and 45 to the B+ side of the centre line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mounting: four M4 tapped holes (drill 3.3) at 30 and 167 in,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 30 each side. Screws come up from below and stop in the plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Deburr every hole; the top face must stay flat within 0.1 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: under the gap pad (it carries the MOSFET heat).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: lay the board on it; all six holes line up with the board's.
